title: The 3 Best Dog Crates for Large Breeds
h1: The 3 Best Dog Crates for Large Breeds
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for dog crates for large breeds, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dog crates for large breeds using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: MidWest iCrate 36-Inch Double Door Dog Crate
products.blurb: Key specs: 36"L x 23"W x 25"H, rated for 41 to 70 lb dogs, Front and side doors, Removable divider panel.
strengths: Lowest price per inch of usable space in this category
Divider panel lets one crate serve puppy through adult sizing
Two doors give flexible placement against walls or in corners
limitations: Standard wire gauge, not built for determined chewers or escape artists
Plastic tray can crack after a few years of daily use
No wheels, so repositioning a loaded crate means lifting it
features: 36"L x 23"W x 25"H, rated for 41 to 70 lb dogs

products.name: Carlson Pet Products Double Door Metal Dog Crate, Large 42-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: 42"L x 28"W x 30.5"H, rated up to 95 lbs, Front and side doors, Multi-point locking latch system.
strengths: Heavier wire gauge than basic iCrate-style crates at a similar price
Multi-point latches resist nose-nudging and paw-pawing better than single slide-bolts
42-inch size fits most large breeds without upgrading to a giant crate
limitations: Costs more than the equivalent MidWest size
Heavier to carry between rooms or load into a vehicle
Still a standard wire crate, not rated for extreme chewers
features: 42"L x 28"W x 30.5"H, rated up to 95 lbs

products.name: Go Pet Club 44-Inch Heavy Duty Stackable Dog Crate
products.blurb: Key specs: 44.25"L x 28"W x 32.5"H with wheels, Heavy-gauge stackable wire construction, Removable divider and two water bowls included.
strengths: Heaviest wire gauge of any crate in this roundup
Wheels make it far easier to move than the MidWest or Carlson
Stackable design is genuinely useful for multi-dog households or kennels
limitations: Assembly reportedly goes faster with two people
Some buyers report weld quality issues on individual units
Largest, bulkiest footprint even when folded
features: Removable divider and two water bowls included
Stacks up to three tiers for multi-dog storage

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
